newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Kia to make trucks in Brazil - paper.
newsitem.headline: Kia to make trucks in Brazil - paper.

text.p: Kia Motors Corp will build a plant in Brazil next year to make K 2400 trucks, local newspapers said.
Kia Motors do Brasil president Jose Luiz Gandini will travel to Korea in the second half of January to negotiate details with the company, O Estado de Sao Paulo daily said.
Gandini was quoted as saying that the plant will not be located in the northeast of Brazil despite tax incentives granted to car makers with plans to invest in the region.
The newspaper said Gandini is studying the possibility of building the plant in the states of Sao Paulo, Minas Gerais, Rio de Janeiro or Parana.
